title: Planned maintenance: NBN services connected via the South Morang (3SMR) POI, Victoria
current_summary: Planned maintenance is now underway at the South Morang (3SMR) NBN point of interconnect in Victoria. The work started at 12:00 am AEDT on Friday 23 October 2026 and is scheduled to finish by 3:00 am AEDT. NBN services connected through this location may be disrupted for up to 3 hours during this window. We are moving services from older network connections to new ones, and not every service will be affected for the full window.

cause.reason: Planned maintenance to move services from legacy network connections to new ones at the South Morang NBN point of interconnect.
